name: JL_BR_AR_COLL_DOCS_DET_ALL
description: This table stores the details of the collection documents.

columns.name: COLL_DOCS_DET_ID
columns.description: Brazilian receivables collection document unique identifier.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Brazilian receivables payment schedule unique identifier.

columns.name: SELECTION_CONTROL_ID
columns.description: Brazilian receivables collections batch unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Brazilian receivables collection document unique identifier.

columns.name: TERMS_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Terms sequence number of a Brazilian receivables collection document.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date of the Brazilian receivables collection document.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Customer transaction unique identifier in the Brazilian receivables collection document.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SELECT_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Brazilian Receivables Account Selection Control unique identifier.
